_note: Derived fixture. It REPLACED fixtures/claims/ on 2026-09-10, when this repository was made public. That directory held 210 claim strings (208 distinct) frozen from four of the owner's UNPUBLISHED drafts; the claim text discloses what those pieces are about, so it could not ship. The claim text is deliberately absent and is not recoverable from this file.  What the claims were for: THRESHOLDS.minClaimChars = 16 and THRESHOLDS.harvestSeedChars = 21 are bound by test/classify/claim-floor.test.ts, which re-derives its measurement from lengths and counts. Lengths and counts are what this file preserves.  `lengths` is every distinct claim's norm(claim).length, one integer each, sorted ascending - the order in fixtures/claims/ was itself information about the drafts and nothing here needs it. `spurious` is the complete set of claims that matched a `document` fixture they were not written about, with their normalized length and hit count; both are meaningless fragments, exactly what the floor exists to refuse, so they disclose nothing. `documentFixtures` is the count of kind="document" entries in fixtures/corpus.json at the freeze.  No summary figure (count, max, min, refusals at F) is stored: every one is derivable from `lengths`, and a stored copy is a number that can go quietly false against the array beside it.  Derived 2026-09-10 from the claims by norm() and phraseFound() out of dist/, the same functions scripts/calibrate-claim-floor.mjs used on 2026-09-09; every figure in docs/calibration-2026-09.md's "Calibration of minClaimChars and harvestSeedChars" section reproduces from it, except the cross-document assertion, which needed the strings.
